task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: Navigate to box stack, pick BOX_TOP and place on TEMP_TABLE, pick BOX_MIDDLE and place on INSPECTION_TABLE, then retrieve BOX_TOP from TEMP_TABLE and place it back on BOX_BOTTOM to restore the stack.
assumptions: BOX_TOP is currently the top box on the stack and must be moved first to access BOX_MIDDLE.
TEMP_TABLE is available as a temporary holding location.
NavTo with tolerance 0.5 brings the robot within interaction_distance (2.0) of targets.
Placing BOX_TOP back on BOX_BOTTOM will successfully restore the stack without the middle box.
